title: A/R Detail: the group row stays pinned under the headings
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • On today's date the report has two buckets, {Bucket-A} and the next bucket below it, {Bucket-B}, each with more lines than fit on the screen.
    For example: {Bucket-A} is "31-60 days past due" and {Bucket-B} is "1-30 days past due".
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with the groups of {Bucket-A} and {Bucket-B} expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Scroll down slowly into {Bucket-A}'s rows.
  2. Look at the pinned row.
  3. Keep scrolling until {Bucket-B}'s row reaches the top.
  4. Keep scrolling into {Bucket-B}'s rows.
  5. Scroll back up slowly until you are inside {Bucket-A}'s rows again.
  6. Scroll down fast through {Bucket-A}'s and {Bucket-B}'s rows, then fast back up.
  7. Make the browser window 1200 px wide.
  8. Scroll the table sideways to the right.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Bucket-A}'s row stays pinned just under the column headings while its rows scroll beneath it.
  • Step 2: it shows the bucket's chevron (pointing down) and its label: the bucket's name and count; it shows no amounts (the bucket's sums stay in its own subtotal row).
  • Step 3: {Bucket-B}'s row pushes {Bucket-A}'s row up and off and takes its place; only one group row is pinned at a time.
  • Step 4: {Bucket-B}'s row stays pinned.
  • Step 5: the change reverses: {Bucket-A}'s row comes back down into the pinned place.
  • Step 6: at speed too, each pinned row is pushed up and replaced cleanly: it never covers the column headings or the Totals row at the bottom, and two group rows never overlap.
  • Step 7: the table now scrolls sideways (narrower than 1440 px).
  • Step 8: each group row's label ({Bucket-A}'s label) stays visible at the left while the columns move.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S4-R6: “While the user scrolls through an expanded group, that group's row (the bucket label, customer or vendor) stays pinned just under the column headings. Only one group row is held at a time: when the next group's row reaches it, the next row pushes it up and off and takes its place. Scrolling back reverses this.”
  • S4-R7: “When the table scrolls sideways, each group row's label stays visible at the left.”
  • S8-R3: “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns), column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D21: “Pinned group row = scroll-driven overlay (ReportPinnedGroupRow + useReportPinnedGroup) showing the group row's chevron and full label — on A/R Collection including "Phone:" and "Credit term:" (S9-R1/R2) — but no money cells (the group's subtotals stay in its own row)”
  • Tech plan §7 Manual testing checklist: “3. Fling-scroll a long expanded group: pinned row pushes up without overlapping header or totals.”
